verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own docs describe a dedicated Chrome/Brave/Edge/Chromium profile that the agent controls, plus agent-controlled browser automation and 'live browser automation' in the release notes, so the core capability is first-party. The pack never documents the individual actions the story names: navigating, logging in, clicking, or extracting from live pages. missing for 10: documented navigate/click/login/extraction actions, authenticated-session handling details, independent hands-on corroboration of browser control.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf

citations.quote: OpenClaw can run a **dedicated Chrome/Brave/Edge/Chromium profile** that the agent controls.
OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant for messaging, browser, desktop, and automation workflows.
